Virtual Deployment

The computer(s) are shipped directly to the provided address. Once the device is received, you will call us and we will help you configure your device.



Onsite Deployment

The computer(s) are shipped either to the provided address or our office. Once the device is received, we will come onsite to help you configure your device.
